input.headline: Haaland blanks again as captain while Evanilson keeps on scoring

cards.text: The armband went to Haaland for a 10th gameweek running, and he drew a blank at Nott'm Forest. Groß was the captain who delivered.

cards.title: Hauls from the eight-goal draw
cards.text: Man Utd and Aston Villa traded blows in a 4-4 draw. N.Jackson was the one many managers owned, scoring in a third gameweek running.
The bandwagon rolled on happily, with Evanilson scoring again. Sellers of João Pedro were proved right once more.

cards.title: Popular picks, mixed fortunes
cards.text: Groß ended a run of blanks in the 2-0 win over Brentford, while Rogers drew nothing from Chelsea's defeat at Sunderland.

items.text: shared the top score with two goals and an assist against Coventry City
